connector.name: MCP Identity
connector.registryDescription: DoI score lookup, vouch event builder, and offline schnorr verify for AI agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-identity. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zekebuilds-lab account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: ORACLE_URL
env.description: PowForge Depth-of-Identity oracle base URL. Defaults to public production endpoint when running via npx; override for self-hosted or local dev.

env.name: ORACLE_PUBKEY
env.description: Schnorr pubkey of the DoI oracle, used for offline envelope verification. Defaults to the production PowForge oracle pubkey; override only if pointing at a self-hosted oracle.
